title: Customer detail page loads for AP/AR role (Fees & Discounts on)
custom_preconds:
1. The organization has the Fees & Discounts feature turned ON.
  2. You have a role with these permissions turned ON: Customer Management → Create & Edit, See Financial Data, and Manage AP/AR.
  3. That role has NO Settings / organization permissions.
  4. A user is signed in with that role.
custom_steps:
1. Open any customer.
  2. Look at the customer detail page (Work Orders / Payments / Invoices tabs).
  3. Open the customer's Fees & Discounts tab.
custom_expected:
The customer detail page opens normally. All tabs (Work Orders, Payments, Invoices) are reachable.

You are NOT sent to a full-page "Access restricted" screen.

The customer Fees & Discounts tab loads for this role.

If the same role does NOT have Manage AP/AR, the customer page still opens normally (the Fees & Discounts area is simply hidden) — a background permission check must never lock the whole page.
refs: SV-8701 (Fees & Discounts customer default-adjustments gate, S13-R9: Customers Create & Edit + Manage AP/AR)
evidence: LIVE 2026-07-27, staging (FeesAndDiscounts flag confirmed ON for org d55bc308). POSITIVE role atoms {customersCreateAndEdit, customersView, seeApArData, seeFinancialData} (no org grants): GET /api/customers/{id}/default-adjustments = 200; /customers/{id} loaded in Chromium (FINAL URL /customers/{id}/work-orders, real customer detail, ZERO 4xx); /customers/{id}/fees-and-discounts loaded, ZERO 4xx. NEGATIVE role (no seeApArData): default-adjustments = 403 but customer page STILL loaded (ZERO 4xx in UI; FE skips the fetch). SV-8701 = FIXED. Screenshots: evidence/cust_pos.png, evidence/cust_neg.png.
note: Regression guard for the FE-allows/BE-blocks whole-page lockout class (same family as SV-7958). Currently PASSES.
